statement: For every simple99-vertex degree14 graph with adjacent common-neighbor count1 and nonadjacent count2, any actual induced subset adjacency H and exact exterior type counts n_i necessarily admit per-copy integer neighbor profiles of outside degree14-|t_i| and type-incidence vector2*1-(H+I)t_i, with own-copy capacities and justified adjacency-bit restrictions. Their directed aggregate edge totals are symmetric off diagonal and even on diagonal and satisfy the corresponding count-weighted degree/incidence equations and zero/full capacities. Mandatory/free copy selection gives exact necessary min/max overlap bounds for every subset of induced points. No equitable partition, completion sufficiency or target occurrence is asserted.
